purpose: Cover AC-2801-1 through AC-2801-8 via unit tests over the shipped application-onboarding-tour blueprint.json contribution shape (17 contributions in the 4 REQ / 7 US / 3 TAC / 3 ADR groups), the ADR shape and standardsTraceClause discipline on the ADR contribution entries per spec section 8a, the applies-clean pass on a fresh init project (no requiresAppliedCapabilities), the pack-loader accepting the shipped pack file with every check id cross-checked against blueprint AC ids and appliesTo referencing BOTH tacIds and route, the sample-app fixture serving the tour surface honestly on both apps=dashboard and apps= (empty) branches plus multiple store branches, the four break switches surfacing the four defects (no-role, focus-escape, no-collapse, no-persist), the docs consistency (README, guide, topics.md, blueprint CHANGELOG) and the withUrl helper plus browser.resize breakpoint usage (WCAG 2.4.11) in the pack source.
title: application-onboarding-tour v1.0.0 shelf shape, probe pack cross-check, sample-app fixture with dashboard-and-settings-page checklist branches and multiple completion-store branches, and the four break switches under Q4 spa-local-storage fallback
